service.description: Connect to the StaffDeck digital employee service and manage its base URL, deployment API key and external user id in one place.
service.connectionDescription: When enabled the employee catalog is loaded from StaffDeck; the app falls back to local data when the service is unavailable.
service.modeMock: Current mode: local mock. Employee data comes from the built-in catalog.
service.modeRemote: Current mode: StaffDeck service. Employee data comes from the remote service.
service.invalidBaseUrl: Enter an http:// or https:// URL without embedded credentials.
service.apiKeyKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the saved key
service.apiKeyConfigured: An API key is saved. It is encrypted in the system credential store and never shown again.
service.toggleApiKeyVisibility: Show or hide the API key
service.externalUserIdHint: Generated on first open and editable; identifies the calling user.
service.clearApiKeyConfirm: You will need to enter a new key before connecting to StaffDeck again. Continue?
service.saved: Saved. The new configuration is applied without restarting the app.
service.saveFailed: Saving failed. Check the values and try again.
service.loadFailed: Failed to load the current configuration. Please try again later.

testResults.ok: Connected successfully and the employee payload is valid.
testResults.missingConfig: Incomplete configuration: provide a valid base URL, API key and external user id.
testResults.unauthorized: Authentication failed. Check that the API key is correct and still valid.
testResults.httpError: The service returned an error status. Try again later or contact the administrator.
testResults.networkError: Cannot reach the service. Check the base URL and your network.
testResults.invalidPayload: The service response did not match the expected format. Check the service version.

banner.degraded: StaffDeck service is unavailable. Showing local mock digital employees.

remote.awaitingHint: Reply in the input box below to continue in the cloud.

error.generic: Cloud execution failed. Please try again later.
error.insufficientScope: The service API key lacks the required scopes. Ask an administrator to grant runs/sessions access.
error.apiKeyRequired: No valid service API key is configured. Add one in settings.
error.apiKeyExpired: Servis API anahtarının süresi doldu. Ayarlardan yeni bir anahtar girin.
error.apiKeyRevoked: Servis API anahtarı iptal edildi. Yöneticiden yeni bir anahtar isteyin.
error.agentNotFound: The service cannot find this digital employee; it may be offline or not synced.
error.sessionNotFound: The service session no longer exists. Start a new conversation.
error.runNotFound: The service cannot find this run. Send the message again.
error.sessionConflict: This conversation is already bound to another digital employee.
error.runNotSucceeded: The run did not finish normally, so the result may be incomplete.
error.runFailed: Cloud execution failed. Try again later or contact the service administrator.
error.llmError: Model çağrısı servis tarafında başarısız oldu. Tekrar deneyin veya model yapılandırmasını kontrol edin.
error.actionBudget: Çalıştırma bu tur için otomatik adım sınırına ulaştı. Sonraki turda devam etmek için yanıtlayın.
error.capabilityUnavailable: Bu çalışanın ihtiyaç duyduğu bir yetenek şu anda kullanılamıyor. Daha sonra tekrar deneyin veya yöneticiye başvurun.
error.streamInterrupted: The connection to the cloud was interrupted. Send your message again to continue.
error.runInProgress: Another turn is still running in the cloud for this conversation. Wait for it to finish.
error.sessionUnavailable: Could not create the cloud session. Check the service configuration and retry.
error.transportError: Cannot reach the cloud service. Check your network and the base URL.

knowledge.stale: Knowledge for "{knowledgeBaseId}" may be outdated. It will retry in the background.
knowledge.unreachable: Cannot reach the knowledge service right now; "{knowledgeBaseId}" may be stale.
knowledge.noEmbedding: No embedding model is configured, so "{knowledgeBaseId}" cannot be indexed.
knowledge.noEmbeddingAction: Go to Settings → Providers and enable an embedding model, then retry.
knowledge.unauthorized: Access to the knowledge service was denied; syncing "{knowledgeBaseId}" is paused.
knowledge.unauthorizedAction: Check that the StaffDeck API key in Settings is still valid.
